_instructions: Fill in every PENDING field once the permitted data source is confirmed. These values are printed verbatim in the Methodology PDF and the Excel Methodology sheet. Do not describe a method that was not actually used.
acquisition_route: PENDING - one of: (1) Official Letterboxd API with approved access; (2) written permission from Letterboxd for academic research; (3) a dataset whose licence/terms permit this use; (4) researcher-provided review data collected manually without bypassing any access control.
source_description: PENDING - describe exactly what data was obtained, from whom, and under what terms.
permission_reference: PENDING - e.g. date and reference of Letterboxd's written permission / API approval e-mail, or dataset licence name and URL.
collection_period: PENDING - first and last date on which review data was obtained (YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD).
frame_definition: PENDING - which reviews of each film the source made accessible (e.g. all public reviews returned by the approved API endpoint on the collection date).
